source: بازی آموزشی کل دروس سوم ابتدایی.docx — PERSIAN-13 (فارسی سوم، فصل ۶ ایران من، درس ۱۳ درس آزاد); plan 04 row P-13; plan 12 §2 row 6 (VS version: festival story board, 6 slots, open-ended but constrained).
design_note: Slot 1 = the topic (a word card with a pictogram, «انتخاب واژه»). Slots 2–6 = sentence cards, filled top-down without gaps (cards slide up). Any composition is accepted when: every sentence is about the chosen topic, no idea is said twice, the main sentence comes first, a closing sentence (optional) comes last, and at least two detail sentences are used. 44 valid compositions per topic. «ثبت» (the engraving stamp) submits.

reading.note: tap a card → the Reading Card; listen after 3 s. Clips P-13_* are generated in the VO pass (10 per turn); until then the listen button is hidden.
reading.tts_rule: tts_fa = the exact TTS input, LIGHTLY marked (user decision, round 13: full vocalization made the voice worse): text_fa as written + kasra only for a spoken ezafe that is not written (کنارِ), «ـهٔ» for an ezafe after a silent ه, a word-final sukun only where the voice would otherwise add a false ezafe (کتابْ قرض), and a vowel only on known homographs (پُر، گُل). No fatha/damma/tashdid/sukun elsewhere. Stripped of the marks it equals text_fa.

misconceptions.description: card: «چند جمله‌ی جدا از هم = متن منسجم.» — good sentences about another topic are put on the board
more sentences is better: the same idea is said twice to fill the board

mastery.note: card mastery = a short coherent text WITHOUT a full template → the library practice (fixed topic, no pictograms) solved without H2/H3 and without Assist gives level 3.

audio.on_wrong: soft_error — wrong cards wobble, never punishing
audio.on_solve: gentle chime + the board fills with light + luma_motif_3_note_ascending
